name: momentum-panel
title: Momentum Panel
description: A draggable panel that keeps its release velocity: throw it and it coasts with friction, bounces off container edges with restitution, and comes to rest where physics puts it — gesture + inertia in one primitive.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Drag Throw: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
